hard_gates.criterion: a fitted inner garment and a separate loose outer garment remain individually readable. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
reject_substitutes: one loose garment with a printed inner panel
two equally tight layers
bare skin mistaken for an inner garment
unrelated background volume

hard_gates.criterion: Right hand and left arm both belong to the single adult woman; the separate coat does not supply a second body.
The shoulder-height side knob beside her is reachable by a bent arm while her torso stays nearly frontal.
The torso is upright above the knees and lower legs continue under the pelvis toward the level floor. No unusual external body support is demanded.
Right hand contacts the exterior lamp-yoke knob beside her shoulder; coat edges fall outward, allowing access to the knob and leaving torso structure visible.
Head-through-knees almost-frontal projection includes fitted torso, waist, hips, coat boundaries and operative hand in one frame.

supplemental_target_gates.expected: The same opaque one-piece follows torso, waist and hip contours through readable shaped seams and small tension folds.
Solid textile covers chest, abdomen and pelvis continuously.
A separate loose tan coat has outward front edges, broad folds and clear draping distance from the fitted base.
Adult face is readable, with visible short dark bob and airy bangs broadly consistent with the portrait reference; this does not establish identity.
The right hand turns the exterior brass yoke tilt knob, lamp stands beside her, torso is balanced over legs.
Face, fitted torso/waist/hips, both outer coat edges and operative hand coexist visibly in head-through-knees framing.
